changeAddress.description: Your wallet address: it pays the fee and any deposit, gives the collateral, and receives the change. Get it from vector_signer_get_address.

controller.description: The controller key of the new record: an Ed25519 public key, 64 hex characters (vector_signer_get_public_key shows yours)

name.description: Agent name, 1 to 64 bytes of UTF-8

endpoint.description: Endpoint URL, up to 256 bytes (a subagent has none)

capabilities.description: Capability ids, up to 16 of 1 to 64 bytes, no duplicates

keys.description: Listed keys (up to 8): the keys that act for the agent. Each new Ed25519 key signs the registration.

key.description: The public key: 64 hex characters for Ed25519, 66 for a compressed P-256 point

purposes.description: What the key may do: authentication, assertion, transaction, delegation (a P-256 key: authentication and assertion only)

pop.description: P-256 only: the 64-byte ES256 signature by this key over "did:vector:<id>#<key hash>" (r || s, hex)

parties.description: Parties (up to 8). A record needs at least one Accountable Party that covers the validity window (for example { role: "Accountable", signer: "controller" }).

role.description: Accountable, Responsible, Provider, Distributor or Guardian

signer.description: Who signs for the party: 'controller' (whoever is the record's controller), 'module1' (the approved dispute contract; Accountable or Responsible only), or a key hash (56 hex characters)

organisation.description: The DID or domain of an organisation that the party acts for (never a person), 1 to 64 bytes

not_before.description: When the party starts to count; default the start of the validity window (POSIX milliseconds)

not_after.description: When the party stops counting; default never (POSIX milliseconds)

rights.description: The party's rights: suspend, revoke, recover. Default: the highest rights of the role (Accountable suspend+revoke, Responsible and Provider suspend, Distributor none, Guardian recover)

guardian_threshold.description: How many guardians must act together to replace a lost controller key (default 0: no recovery); at most the number of Guardian parties with the recover right

parent.description: The DID of the parent agent, to register a subagent: did:vector:<64 hex> (the bare 64-hex identifier also works)

deposit.description: Units that the record locks (default 10, the minimum); the controller can take it back after the record ends

valid_minutes.description: Minutes from now until the transaction expires (default 30, at most 59): every key holder must sign and the transaction must be submitted before then

supplier_key_hash.description: The supplier key that claims and submits the jobs (default your wallet's key): a key hash, 56 hex characters

capability_id.description: Capability id, at most 64 bytes, outside the fleet namespaces llm.text.generate.*, llm.chat.*, ocr.page.extract.* and audio.synthesize.* (for example research.summary.v1); the agent's record must list it

model.description: Model or service version the supplier runs, at most 64 bytes

max_processing_ms.description: Processing window in milliseconds, from 60001 to 86400000 (24 h): how long the supplier has to submit a job. A vector-agent-template supplier needs at least its SERVICE_TIMEOUT_MS + 60000 (180000 with the default)

price_lovelace.description: Price per job in lovelace (1 unit = 1000000); price + both bonds is at most 10,000 units

detail_hash.description: sha256 (64 hex) of the exact bytes detail_uri serves; required with a detail_uri (this server does not fetch it). Without a detail_uri, omit it (or pass ""): the sha256 of no bytes is used

endpoint_url.description: https URL of your supplier runtime, at most 256 bytes, without whitespace, query or fragment (vector_marketplace_send_job posts jobs to <endpoint_url>/v1/job)

supplier_bond_lovelace.description: Supplier bond in lovelace: a buyer locks price + both bonds per job, and on Accept the supplier receives price + supplier bond

buyer_bond_lovelace.description: Buyer bond in lovelace; it returns to the buyer on Accept

detail_uri.description: Optional https URL of your manifest (agent.json), at most 256 bytes (default none); requires detail_hash

expected_type.description: The type that the attestation must have: identity (0), provenance (1), software (2), environment (3), principal_binding (4), approval (5) or other (15)

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0): the next_offset of the previous answer

jury.description: One jury deployment (script hash or address). Default: every deployment that this server follows

challenge.description: The token name of a Module-1 challenge (64 hex), to show only its cases
